purpose: Read-only screening of non-fusion candidates against the accepted V2 long-epoch profile, requested by the repository owner.

trace.transformation: Previously recorded lossless device display-lane repair; canonical bytes unchanged. GPU timestamps, durations, names, args and actual stream IDs preserved; CPU launch flows retained.

method.window: First CPU microbatch entry through last device completion linked to launches made before third CPU microbatch return.
method.timing: Nanosecond trace timestamps; report milliseconds. Busy and idle use interval unions over recorded local-device streams.
method.exposure: Intersection of communication/kernel/copy intervals with main-stream idle. This is scheduling evidence, not proof of removable delay or speedup.
method.host: Host operation/API durations include waiting/scheduling, not CPU utilization. Capacity synchronization intersection with all-device idle is reported separately.
method.classification: Final cand_kind corrects initial missing hybrid_ep classification. Main idle and GEMM aggregate queries use unique aliases after two GROUP BY alias collisions with the inherited family column.

dispositions.result: Real, bounded scheduling opportunity. Most all-gather is overlapped; 18.918 ms intersects main-stream idle. Reduce-scatter intersects main idle for 36.103 ms, concentrated in token embeddings, MTP and layer0. Required communication is not automatically removable. Current source explicitly waits for gradient-buffer release and post-reduce events.

dispositions.candidate: MoE metadata / quantization overlap, excluding fusion
dispositions.result: Concrete capacity collective and CPU predicate synchronization. 42 capacity checks/host syncs, 39 128-int64/eight-rank all-reduces due SAC collective reuse, and 42 no-drop clones. The 652.941 ms host-sync sum is mostly overlapped; only 6.319 ms intersects all-device idle. Collective durations may include peer waits. No new kernel/algorithm recommendation or token-drop policy change.

Concrete repeated work. 54 scan forward calls and 18 scan backward calls. Of the forward work, 18 calls occur outside torchtitan::gdn_chunk in VJP reconstruction, totaling 8.868 ms of kernels; FLA backward recomputes w/u and h for another 4.063 ms. Removing recomputation would require retaining/reusing valid state with an assessed memory cost. Required SAC settings are preserved.

Low priority from this profile alone: active cuDNN flash SDPA, 29.969 ms of forward/recompute/backward kernels (~2.32% of the sampled elapsed window). This is not the cost of all MLA projections or all layout transformations, nor evidence that another backend is faster.

Memory/computation tradeoff, no demonstrated immediate speed problem. The matched V2 receipt has zero allocation retry/OOM deltas; extra recomputation adds GEMMs. Routed donor rejects FP8. Additional configuration changes are outside this screening.
Poor fit: near-full supervised fixture (4095/4096 main targets), donor rejects MTP, active MTP1.
No established benefit for this full-pretraining crop: preserved same-model smoke records zero frozen parameters.
Bookkeeping improvement; no demonstrated speed bottleneck here.
Already accepted V2. Ready queue evidence is retained in the existing run report/receipts.
Excluded by the preceding user scope, including linear/CE, softcap/CE, hidden z-loss, norm/residual and routing/input preparation fusion.

limits: Only rank0 was queried in this screening. Existing receipts cover ranks0/1 and matched inputs; no new rank1 screening is claimed.
Three microbatches are not a full optimizer update. Remaining29 microbatches, optimizer, full-step tail, prior input producer work and memory peaks are absent.
Profile timings do not establish unprofiled speedup, repeatability, convergence, or production PP4/EP32 behavior.

Current source inspection explains mechanisms; execution source identity and dirty-snapshot digest are kept separately. No training-source/config/runner changes or new training/benchmark were performed.

CREATE PERFETTO TABLE cand_kind AS
SELECT id, CASE WHEN category='gpu_memcpy' THEN 'copy' WHEN category='gpu_memset' THEN 'memset'
WHEN name GLOB '*hybrid_ep*' OR name GLOB '*ag_nvl*' OR name GLOB '*rs_nvl*' OR lower(name) GLOB '*deep_ep*' OR lower(name) GLOB '*deepep*' THEN 'ep'
WHEN lower(name) GLOB '*nccl*' THEN 'nccl' ELSE 'compute' END kind FROM cand_dev;
CREATE PERFETTO TABLE cand_union AS
WITH expanded AS (
SELECT d.id,k.kind,d.b,d.e FROM cand_events d JOIN cand_kind k USING(id)
UNION ALL SELECT id,'all_device',b,e FROM cand_events
UNION ALL SELECT id,'communication',b,e FROM cand_events d WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cand_kind k WHERE k.id=d.id AND k.kind IN ('ep','nccl'))),
p AS (SELECT *,MAX(e) OVER(PARTITION BY kind ORDER BY b,e,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) prev_end FROM expanded)
SELECT kind,count(*) n,sum(e-b)/1e6 sum_ms,sum(MAX(0,e-MAX(b,coalesce(prev_end,b))))/1e6 union_ms FROM p GROUP BY kind;
SELECT kind,n,round(sum_ms,3) sum_ms,round(union_ms,3) union_ms FROM cand_union;

queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cand_dev) device,(SELECT count(*) FROM cand_link) linked,(SELECT count(DISTINCT id) FROM cand_link) distinct_linked,(SELECT sum(value) FROM stats WHERE severity='error') import_errors;

queries.label: attention_gdn
queries.sql: SELECT name,count(*) n,round(sum(dur)/1e6,3) sum_ms FROM cand_dev WHERE category='kernel' AND (lower(name) GLOB '*sdpa*' OR lower(name) GLOB '*chunk*' OR lower(name) GLOB '*delta*' OR lower(name) GLOB '*wy*') GROUP BY name ORDER BY sum(dur) DESC LIMIT 35;

queries.label: host_ops
queries.sql: SELECT name,count(*) n,round(sum(dur)/1e6,3) sum_ms FROM thread_slice WHERE category='cpu_op' AND (name GLOB '*capacity*' OR name GLOB '*gated_delta*' OR name GLOB '*sdpa*' OR name GLOB '*indices_to*' OR name GLOB '*quantiz*' OR name GLOB '*foreach*' OR name GLOB '*all_gather*' OR name GLOB '*hybridep*') GROUP BY name ORDER BY sum(dur) DESC LIMIT 35;

queries.label: largest_gaps
queries.sql: SELECT round(g.gap/1e3,3) gap_us,round((g.b-w.lo)/1e6,3) at_ms,d.id,d.stream,substr(d.name,1,105) next_name,h.host_name,round((h.host_ts-g.prev_end)/1e3,3) launch_after_idle_start_us FROM cand_gaps g JOIN cand_dev d USING(id) JOIN cand_win w LEFT JOIN cand_link h USING(id) ORDER BY g.gap DESC LIMIT 12;

queries.label: main_idle_exposure
queries.sql:
CREATE PERFETTO TABLE cand_main_gaps AS
WITH m AS (SELECT * FROM cand_events WHERE stream=7),
p AS (SELECT *,MAX(e) OVER(ORDER BY b,e,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) prev_end FROM m)
SELECT id,b,e,prev_end,b-prev_end gap FROM p WHERE b>prev_end;
CREATE PERFETTO TABLE cand_main_idle AS
SELECT prev_end b,b e FROM cand_main_gaps
UNION ALL SELECT w.lo,(SELECT min(b) FROM cand_events WHERE stream=7) FROM cand_win w
UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT max(e) FROM cand_events WHERE stream=7),w.hi FROM cand_win w;
SELECT CASE WHEN d.name GLOB '*AllGather*' THEN 'all_gather' WHEN d.name GLOB '*ReduceScatter*' THEN 'reduce_scatter'
WHEN d.name GLOB '*AllReduce*' THEN 'all_reduce' WHEN d.category='gpu_memcpy' THEN 'copy' ELSE 'weight_preparation_kernels' END family,
count(DISTINCT d.id) n,round(sum(MIN(d.e,g.e)-MAX(d.b,g.b))/1e6,3) overlaps_main_stream_idle_ms
FROM cand_events d JOIN cand_main_idle g ON d.b<g.e AND d.e>g.b WHERE d.stream<>7 GROUP BY family;

WITH ag AS(
SELECT d.*, (SELECT a.name FROM ancestor_slice(d.host_id) a WHERE a.name GLOB 'GFSDP::all_gather*' LIMIT 1) owner FROM cand_link d WHERE d.name GLOB '*AllGather*')
SELECT owner,count(*) n,round(sum(dur)/1e6,3) sum_ms,
round(sum((SELECT coalesce(sum(MIN(d.ts+d.dur,g.e)-MAX(d.ts,g.b)),0) FROM cand_main_idle g WHERE d.ts<g.e AND d.ts+d.dur>g.b))/1e6,3) overlaps_main_idle_ms
FROM ag d GROUP BY owner ORDER BY overlaps_main_idle_ms DESC;
